points.description: Explains that the slightly different salt solution is still within the range of tolerance for brine-shrimp eggs, so some eggs can still hatch (equivalent wording accepted).

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating that the different solution falls within the brine shrimp's range of tolerance, allowing some eggs to hatch. No marks for answers that only restate that some eggs hatched or that do not refer to tolerance/acceptable range.
